_note: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Every number is made up for a fictional company. Real inputs must come from your own licensed data (I/B/E/S consensus, Compustat fundamentals, Capital IQ) and the company's own filings. Probabilities and impacts are placeholders for your own scenario work.

states._comment: Mutually exclusive demand states. Probabilities (12m, 24m); the base state takes the residual so they sum to one.

overlays._comment: Overlays can co-occur with any state and with each other. Two-sided: include upside as well as downside events, and ranges may straddle zero.
